issues.description: The problem statement and UML require a constructor that initializes five attributes in the order (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors), but the template's Lecture class provides a constructor with only three parameters (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents). This prevents students from implementing the constructor as specified by the exercise and following the UML order.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the constructor in the template Lecture class to accept all five parameters in the order specified by the UML: (String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors). Keep the constructor body as a TODO or initialize fields appropriately to match the exercise specification so students can implement the rest consistently.
